segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ רַבִּי יִשְׁמָעֵאל אוֹמֵר: עוֹמֶר הָיָה בָּא בַּשַּׁבָּת מִשָּׁלֹשׁ סְאִין, וּבַחוֹל מֵחָמֵשׁ, וַחֲכָמִים אוֹמְרִים: אֶחָד שַׁבָּת וְאֶחָד חוֹל מִשָּׁלֹשׁ הָיָה בָּא.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» «Rabbi Yishmael says:» When the day of the sacrifice of the «omer» meal offering «would» occur «on Shabbat,» the labors performed that would otherwise be prohibited were kept to a minimum, and the one-tenth of an ephah of flour that was «brought» as an offering was processed «from three se’a» of reaped barley. «And» if it occurred «during the week,» the flour was processed «from five» se’a of reaped barley. «And the Rabbis say: Both on Shabbat and» during the «week,» the omer offering «would come from three» se’a of reaped barley.

segments.he: רַבִּי חֲנִינָא סְגַן הַכֹּהֲנִים אוֹמֵר: בַּשַּׁבָּת הָיָה נִקְצָר בְּיָחִיד, וּבְמַגָּל אֶחָד, וּבְקוּפָּה אַחַת, וּבַחוֹל – בִּשְׁלֹשָׁה, בְּשָׁלֹשׁ קוּפּוֹת, וְשָׁלֹשׁ מַגָּלוֹת. וַחֲכָמִים אוֹמְרִים: אֶחָד שַׁבָּת וְאֶחָד חוֹל – בִּשְׁלֹשָׁה, בְּשָׁלֹשׁ קוּפּוֹת, וּבְשָׁלֹשׁ מַגָּלוֹת.
segments.en: «Rabbi Ḥanina, the deputy High Priest, says: On Shabbat» the barley «was reaped by an individual and with one sickle and with one basket» into which the barley was placed; «and during the week,» it was reaped «by three» people «with three baskets and three sickles. And the Rabbis say: Both on Shabbat and» during the «week,» it was reaped «by three» people «with three baskets and with three sickles.»
